summary.value: Leaves on or near the soil first develop a dark, water-soaked lesion and turn light brown, then a gray or brown fuzzy growth of fungal spores appears; a soft rot of leaves and stems develops, plants shrivel and the whole head wilts and rots (beginning with the oldest leaves) until the plant collapses, with abundant gray powdery spore masses and black sclerotia forming under rotted parts.
summary.quote: The initial symptom is a dark, water-soaked lesion. A soft rot of infected leaves and stems occur as the pathogen grows into healthy tissues.
